title: 云海仙踪 更隔蓬山一万重 第一百三十章 护花云海仙踪 更隔蓬山一万重 第一百二十九章 绝色
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
四楼是间琴阁，焚香袅袅，上方就是栋梁交叠的顶阁，再无去路。
此时刺客越来越多，没等他站稳，四周的窗子接连炸碎，又有六道人影连着剑光扑面而至。
许宣目光四扫，不见青帝踪影，瞥见墙上有柄长剑，立即连环飞踢，将桌椅接连不断地朝来人踹去，顺势拔出长剑，回旋怒扫，“当”地气浪激爆，将斜地里冲来的人影撞飞出两丈来远。
一剑在手，如狮虎重获爪牙。流激涌，源源不断地破锋而出，四周惨叫迭起，血肉横飞。那些刺客显然没想到这少年竟有如此恐怖的真，猝不及防，转眼间便有五六人被他刺死、刺伤。
然而他的真气虽然狂猛无比，会使的剑招却少之又少，除了程仲甫那套“铁剑诀”，就只有林灵素所传的三十六路剑法。加上此前一直与小青双剑合璧，几无独自对战的临敌经验，更毋论抱着一人，以寡敌众了。相持片刻，声势很快又被压了下去，只能依仗着凌厉的剑气逼退众人。
刺客越来越多，见他翻来覆去只会这几十招剑法，心下大宽，或呼啸着轮番夹击，或游离在外，伺机攻其不备。这些人个个修为高绝，按大宋道门的各层境界划分，
许宣应接不暇，还要顾护怀里的红衣女子，顿时捉襟见肘，险象环生。又急又恼，纵声喝道：“青帝，快给滚我出来男子汉大丈夫，要死则死，拿女人当挡箭牌，算什么本事……”
话音未落，“当”地一声，长剑脱手，右臂剧痛入骨，接着后背、右腿齐齐被剑气刺中，身子一晃，再也支持不住，顿时趔趄扑倒。然而倒地的那一刹那，仍本能地将红衣女子护在怀里，翻身急滚。
众刺客欢声啸呼，光芒晃动，剑气纵横劈刺而来。
生死一发，已经顾不得暴露身份了，他握住“紫龙”，正想拼死而战，“嘭”地一声剧震，光浪冲爆，那十几柄刺来的长剑突然穿透阁顶，破空飞去。
继而红影一闪，怀中女子鬼魅似的翻飞疾掠。所到之处，气浪怒放如菊，惨叫迭起。许宣甚至还来不及看清发生了什么事，那十几个刺客已捂着喉咙，血箭喷射，破窗坠落湖中。
然而偌大的“百花宫”似乎已被刺客完全控制了，“嗖嗖”连声，火箭怒舞，接连不断地穿入阁里，刹那间烈焰高窜，浓烟滚滚。
红衣女子一把抓住他的手臂，另一手抱起古琴，翩然跃出窗子，凌波御风，踩着跌宕的浮冰朝不远处的台榭掠去。
回头望去，火光冲天，照得天湖彤红一片，那座莲花顶的楼阁已完全烧了起来，在雪山、星穹的映衬下，灼灼紫红，更显壮丽。
数以百计的艳红火矢正越过燃烧的楼阁，穿过夜空，破风激啸着没入他们身边的水波里;数以百计的人影正从四面八方包抄围追，剑光怒舞，长呼着朝他们冲来。
红衣女子拉着他冲上台榭，旋身坐定，双手疾拂琴弦。霎时间碧光乱舞，一道道光弧从琴弦上飞旋而出，火矢应声纵横炸飞，冲在最前的几道人影被光弧扫中，亦惨叫着翻身坠落，鲜血直射。
许宣又惊又佩，想不到这女子竟能以琴为弓，以气为箭，真之强猛，简直匪夷所思转念又想，她既是青帝最得宠的侍妾，受其“阴阳指”的真传，倒也不足为奇。
他素好打抱不平，眼看着数百人围攻这女子，义愤填膺，至于她是谁，反倒变得不重要了。听那琴声杀气凌厉，慷慨激烈，更不由热血沸腾，只恨自己右臂、右腿、后背均受重伤，一时再难挥剑杀敌。
琴声越来越急，漫天都是缤纷闪耀的碧弧，撞得箭矢碎断乱舞，片刻间，又有十几人被光弧劈中，惨叫着坠入天湖，殷红泛起。
然而众寡悬殊，她真气再强，也难挡住四面八方源源不绝冲来的敌手。“嘭嘭”连声，几道飞剑破空而至，被“琴箭”弹得偏移数寸，贴着他的身沿飞过，接着又有几柄彗星般没入数尺外的石台，“嗡嗡”直振。

红衣女子冷笑一声，指尖勾弹，琴声陡然一变，凄厉如壑谷阴风，万鬼齐哭。许宣心中一颤，仿佛有无数虫蚁爬过，又麻又痒，说不出的难受。
左侧率先冲来的两个黑衣人刚跃上台榭，听见那琴声，脸色陡然一变，鲜血从双耳直射而出，惨叫着翻身滚落。
接着右侧、后方冲来的几个黑衣人也如遭电殛，发狂似的尖声嘶叫，接二连三坠入湖中。
远处众人大凛，纷纷撕下衣帛，塞住双耳。饶是如此，仍被那穿透力极强的尖利笛声搅得心烦意乱，气血翻腾。真气稍弱的，只觉全身血液都随着笛声往头顶涌去，头痛欲爆，别说继续进攻，就连踏波站稳的力气也没有了。
content_en:
On the fourth floor is a Qin Pavilion, where incense is burning. Above is the top pavilion with overlapping pillars and no way out.
At this time, there were more and more assassins. Before he could stand firm, the surrounding windows were blown to pieces one after another, and six more figures rushed towards him with sword lights.
Xu Xuan glanced around, but there was no sign of the Qing Emperor. He caught a glimpse of a long sword on the wall, and immediately kicked the tables and chairs towards the intruders one after another. He pulled out the long sword and swept furiously. The air wave on the ground exploded, knocking the figure rushing from the side of the ground two feet away.
With a sword in hand, like a liger regaining its claws. The current surged forward and burst out continuously. Screams broke out all around, and flesh and blood flew everywhere. Those assassins obviously did not expect that this young man could be so terrifying. They were caught off guard, and in the blink of an eye, five or six people were stabbed to death or injured by him.
However, although his true energy was extremely fierce, he could only perform very few sword moves. Apart from Cheng Zhongfu's "Iron Sword Technique", he only had the thirty-six sword techniques taught by Lin Lingsu. In addition, he had been fighting with Xiaoqing with two swords before, so he had little experience in fighting the enemy alone, let alone holding one person against a large number of enemies. After a moment of stalemate, the momentum was quickly suppressed, and they could only rely on the sharp sword energy to push back everyone.
There were more and more assassins. Seeing him tossing and turning and knowing only these dozens of sword skills, he felt relieved. Some were whistling and attacking in turns, or they were wandering outside, waiting for opportunities to attack him unprepared. Each of these people has a high level of cultivation, and they are divided according to the realms of the Taoist sects of the Great Song Dynasty.
Xu Xuan was overwhelmed and had to take care of the woman in red in his arms. He was suddenly stretched thin and surrounded by dangers. Anxious and annoyed, he shouted loudly: "Qing Emperor, get out of here! I'm a man. If you want to die, you will die. Using women as a shield, what kind of skills do you have..."
Before he finished speaking, there was a "dang" sound, and the long sword fell out of his hand, and his right arm suffered severe pain to the bones. Then his back and right leg were stabbed by the sword energy. His body swayed, he could no longer hold up, and he staggered down. However, the moment he fell to the ground, he still instinctively held the woman in red in his arms and rolled over.
The assassins roared in joy, the light swayed, and the sword energy struck vertically and horizontally.
At the moment of life and death, he no longer cared about exposing his identity. He held the "Purple Dragon" and was about to fight to the death. There was a loud "bang", the wave of light exploded, and the dozens of long swords suddenly penetrated the roof of the pavilion and flew through the air.
Then a red shadow flashed, and the woman in his arms flew around like a ghost. Wherever it went, the air waves bloomed like chrysanthemums, and screams occurred repeatedly. Xu Xuan didn't even have time to see clearly what happened. The dozen assassins were clutching their throats, spraying blood arrows, breaking the window and falling into the lake.
However, the huge "Hundred Flowers Palace" seemed to have been completely controlled by the assassins. "Swish" sounds were heard repeatedly, and rockets danced angrily, penetrating into the pavilion one after another. In an instant, flames shot high and thick smoke billowed.
The woman in red grabbed his arm, picked up the guqin in her other hand, jumped out of the window, rode the wind, stepped on the stumbling ice floes, and rushed towards the pavilion not far away.
Looking back, the fire was soaring into the sky, illuminating the sky and lake in red. The lotus-roofed pavilion had been completely burned. Against the backdrop of the snow-capped mountains and starry sky, it glowed purple-red, making it even more magnificent.
Hundreds of bright red fire arrows were flying across the burning pavilion and through the night sky, and the breaking wind roared into the water waves around them; hundreds of figures were surrounding and chasing them from all directions, with swords dancing angrily and rushing towards them with long shouts.
The woman in red pulled him up to the pavilion, turned around and sat down, and flicked the strings of the piano with her hands. In an instant, blue light danced wildly, and arcs of light flew out from the strings. Fire arrows exploded in all directions. The figures in the front were swept by the arcs of light, and they also screamed and fell over, bleeding directly.
Xu Xuan was surprised and admired. He didn't expect that this woman could use the piano as a bow and Qi as arrows. She was so powerful. It was simply unbelievable. Then he thought about it. Since she was the most favored concubine of the Qing Emperor, it was not surprising that she received the true inheritance of his "Yin and Yang Finger".
He always liked to fight against injustice. Seeing hundreds of people besieging this woman, he was filled with righteous indignation. As for who she was, he changed his mind.It doesn't matter anymore. Hearing the murderous and generous sound of the piano, he couldn't help but feel his blood boiling. He only regretted that his right arm, right leg, and back were seriously injured, and he could no longer swing his sword to kill the enemy.
The sound of the piano became more and more urgent, and the sky was filled with colorful and shining green arcs, which caused the arrows to break and dance wildly. In a moment, more than a dozen people were hit by the arcs of light, and fell into the sky lake screaming, with a bright red color.
However, the numbers were vastly outnumbered, and no matter how strong her true energy was, she could not stop the enemies coming from all directions. "Bang bang" was heard continuously, and several flying swords came through the air. They were deflected a few inches by the "harp arrows" and flew close to his body. Then several more swords sank into the stone platform a few feet away like comets, vibrating with a "buzzing" sound.
The woman in red sneered and played with her fingertips. The sound of the piano suddenly changed, as shrill as the wind in the valley, and all the ghosts cried together. Xu Xuan's heart trembled, as if countless insects and ants were crawling over him, making him feel numb and itchy, and felt indescribably uncomfortable.
The two men in black who were the first to rush in from the left had just jumped onto the pavilion. When they heard the sound of the piano, their expressions suddenly changed. Blood shot out from both ears, and they rolled over and rolled down with screams.
Then several men in black who rushed from the right and behind also screamed like they were being electrocuted, screaming like crazy, and fell into the lake one after another.
The people in the distance were so shocked that they tore off their clothes and stuffed their ears. Even so, he was still disturbed by the sharp and penetrating sound of the flute, and his blood was boiling. Those whose true energy was slightly weak felt that all the blood in their bodies was rushing to the top of their heads with the sound of the flute, and they had a headache. Not to mention continuing to attack, they even had no strength to stand firm on the waves.
